Our Luxury Camp Features
A 5 Stars Desert Camp at Wadi Rum set among the red dunes of Wadi Rum.
Delicious organic breakfast
We are proud of our services and eco-camp quality. You will especially notice this with our extensive organic fair trade breakfast, It therefore comes as no surprise that this breakfast is an absolute favorite with our guests.
Atmospheric Desert Tent
Relax and enjoy a drink by the fireplace of pure Arabic traditional coffee or tea in our atmospheric and relaxing tent in the heart of Wadi Rum desert. Furthermore, our reception desk is available 24/7.
Internet and more
The entire Camp - meaning every room - offers a free broadband WiFi connection. In addition, every room is equipped with power sockets allowing you to use your devices anywhere in the camp.
Book a Quality Room
We provides guests with as much comfort as possible.
Comfort Single Room
Our comfortable single rooms are just the right size if you are travelling alone. Similar to all the other rooms in the Al Sultana Luxury Camp, the single room is fully equipped with all comforts.
Book Now
Comfort Double Room
Warmth, luxury and peace meet you in our charming standard double room. In addition to the plush beds, the room (16 m²) is equipped with all amenities theAl Sultana Luxury Camp has to offer.
Book Now
Comfort Twin Room
The luxury interior of our rooms invites you to relax and enjoy what the Al Sultana Luxury Camp has to offer. In addition to the two comfy beds, The rooms are fully equipped for a relaxing stay.
